name: Nixo
long_description:
Scale deployed revenue with the only data layer and agent platform built for how FDEs actually work.

Your deployment capacity boils down to how many accounts your team can stay on top of. We figured out how you can create more of it with the FDE motion you already have.

Nixo is built on what the best FDE teams already know: when everyone has a clear view of what was promised, where every account stands, what needs attention next, and what can be reused from past work, the whole team can carry more deployments with ease. Nixo automatically captures the full history and live health of every account from pre-sales through post-go-live, no matter who worked on it last or where the information lives. Our agents use that context to find, scope, and prioritize work across the portfolio, so anyone can move any account forward.

Join the hundreds of FDE teams scaling deployment capacity with Nixo and finally unlock SaaS-level margins from your services.
one_liner: Make every FDE on your team capable of moving any account forward.

launches.title: Nixo - The first ops platform for forward deployed engineers
launches.tagline: Do things that don't scale, at scale
launches.body:
TL;DR We enable forward deployed engineers to cut time to customer impact.

https://youtu.be/e5mBrBmGAFM

You wouldn’t give a Formula 1 driver a Honda Civic with rocket engines strapped on. But that’s what most companies do to their FDEs right now. These engineers MacGyver their way through every customer project using sales, technical, and support infrastructure that was never meant to accelerate what FDEs do. The result? Companies hit a wall sooner than they should. FDEs are overextended, and there’s no room to take on more customers.

**Most orgs think custom implementations are slow because each one is too unique. In reality, FDEs lose days chasing customers for details and redoing overlapping work.**

We talked to 100+ FDEs to build the ops platform that finally cuts the friction and bloat slowing them down.

**With Nixo, you can** **scope customer problems faster, discover opportunities to reuse code, and get instant visibility into workload across accounts.** Our approach is simple but effective: we pull information from Slack, GitHub, Linear, and CRMs, and organize it to match the flow of real FDE work.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93052&key=user_uploads/878307/50a6e373-27e1-4c98-98d6-ec4676fc3fff)

Hi 👋 we’re Priya and Priti. As FDEs at startups, we felt the pain of managing high-touch deployments without the right tools. And as more teams deploy AI into complex customer environments, we believe the FDE model is here to stay. But making it sustainable and scalable takes more than just iPaaS or better coding agents — it takes the right ops infrastructure.

If you're selling to enterprises, building agents for verticals, or scaling your FDE team, you’ll want to see what we’re working on. Reach out to [**priya@withnixo.com**](mailto:priya@withnixo.com) or [**schedule a 15 minute chat**](https://cal.com/priya-nixo/15min).
